_comment: ALLOWLIST, not a denylist — fail-closed by design (see
docs/proposals/config-only-deploy/context.md and
reality-flow-authentication/infra/config-only-allowed-params.json for the
full rationale).
This is a static site (S3 + CloudFront), not a Lambda service — every
one of its 8 CFN parameters is pure infrastructure topology (domain,
cert, price class, WAF), nothing app-runtime. But 'config-only' here
still only ever means 'skip npm ci + vite build + s3 sync' (infra/
config-deploy.sh, --skip-build) — it is a SEPARATE, DISTINCT axis from
'skip the CFN update' (infra/content-deploy.sh, --skip-cfn, for a pure
VITE_*-only change, which is baked into the JS bundle at build time and
can never skip the build regardless of whether any CFN parameter also
changed). See docs/proposals/config-only-deploy/context.md's category 1
vs. category 3 for why these are two axes, not one.
Deliberately NOT listed, and why:
EnvironmentName  — identity of the stack itself.
BucketName       — the PHYSICAL resource name of the S3 bucket this
template creates — changing it makes CloudFormation
try to REPLACE the bucket (serving the site from a
bucket that doesn't have the deployed content),
not a config tweak.
